newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c. bank one-week refinancing funds rise.
newsitem.headline: Romania c. bank one-week refinancing funds rise.

text.p: The National Bank of Romania said it has raised one-week refinancing funds on offer at Thursday's auction by 100 billion lei to 500 billion lei.
The central bank's one-week minimum permitted rate remained unchanged at 49 percent.
At last week's refinancing auction, the one-week rate rose to 52.75 percent from a previous 50.19 percent following an oversubscription of the central bank's funds.
Auction results are expected on FXRP later on Thursday or early on Friday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
